title: Found items sometimes carry a named future payoff in their flyover text (e.g. a name-carved buckle: 'Mara, on Stilt Row, would want to know this was found') that never appears as a tracked quest in status, so it is easy to finish the game still holding loose narrative threads with no record they exist.
